Packet tools and customization

SmartBeacon and APRS Mute

The development build of v0.1.5 adds automatic SmartBeacon and timed APRS position reports, plus an option to mute packet audio. APRS transmission requires an amateur radio licence.

Full KISS TNC

Use the optional APRS modem update in v0.1.5 and connect over Bluetooth to packet apps such as Pat or Paracon. The updater provides the bridge and setup instructions.

Make Toolbox your own

Add, update, or remove apps, see how much space is available, and set a custom boot logo over Bluetooth or experimental USB-C.

Open App Manager

Brick Breaker and Maze Chase

Clear 30 bricks with a bouncing ball or collect every dot while four prowlers chase you. Both games use the radio’s keypad and install from App Manager.

From install to your first app

To try this experimental firmware, have your TD-H9, a USB-C data cable, and a computer running Chrome or Edge.

  1. Install the firmware. The updater walks you through connecting, saving a recovery backup and installing.
  2. Add your apps. Turn the radio on normally, connect in App Manager over Bluetooth or experimental USB-C, and choose Write to radio after selecting your apps.
  3. Open an app. Hold Back on the channel screen, then select an app with Menu.
Open the firmware updater

Common questions

What if the install is interrupted?

Keep your recovery backup. Hold PTT + 2 while turning the radio on to reconnect in update mode, then follow the TD-H9 recovery guide to retry or restore from the backup.

Can I go back to stock firmware?

Yes. Choose Stock Type-C v1.0.38 in the firmware updater. To restore your original startup image too, save it in App Manager before changing it.

How do I change the startup image?

In App Manager, save a copy of your current logo, pick a PNG or JPG, and write it to your radio. App Manager converts the image for the TD-H9’s 160 × 128 screen.

What is KISS TNC support?

H9 Toolbox Firmware v0.1.5 offers an optional APRS modem update for using the TD-H9 with compatible packet-radio software over Bluetooth. Look for Optional: Unlock KISS TNC after the v0.1.5 updater confirms that the modem update was staged.

Who makes H9 Toolbox Firmware?

H9 Toolbox is an independent, open-source project. View the firmware source and build tools on GitHub.

Doom for the TD-H9

Try Freedoom’s first level on the TD-H9 with a separate experimental firmware. To use the radio again afterward, reinstall H9 Toolbox Firmware or stock.
